title: MGIT Shines at AI Days 2025 – Largest AI Conference Held at Tech Mahindra, Hyderabad - MGIT

## MGIT Shines at AI Days 2025 – Largest AI Conference Held at Tech Mahindra, Hyderabad

News Date : 15 Apr 2025News ReportSwecha Foundation successfully organizedAI Hack Day 2025, a multi-domain hackathon competition featuring over120 real-world problemsin areas such as Art, Music, Video, Agriculture, Education, Healthcare, Gaming, and Storytelling. The event began with the preliminary round held on25th January 2024, where72 teams from MGITparticipated.We are proud to announce that21 MGIT teamswere shortlisted asfinalistsfor theAI Days 2025 – International Conference, held on12th and 13th April 2025atTech Mahindra, Hitech City, Hyderabad. These finalist teams competed in the final round and are now being offeredinternship opportunities by top industries.Among the finalists,two MGIT teams emerged as winners:🏆Team Aarambh – 1st Place in Innovation Domain👩‍💻 Aditi Srigineedi – 21261A6701👩‍💻 Suchita Prakash – 21261A0557👨‍💻 Attaluri Sriram Satwik – 22261A6704🥈Team Connect – 2nd Place in EdTech Domain👨‍💻 Mohammad Wahaj Uddin – 23261A1243👨‍💻 Malluri Vikas – 23261A1232👨‍💻 Mohammed Abrar – 23261A0445The event witnessed participation from over1500 students and professionals, making it one of thelargest AI gatheringsin the region. Eminent speakers such asIAS Officer Mr. Bhavesh Mishra(Deputy Secretary, IT and Electronics Department, Govt. of Telangana),Dr. Pratap Reddy, andDr. Rameshinspired the audience with insights into the future of AI in governance and industry. Mr. Bhavesh Mishra also emphasized theTelangana Government’s initiatives and funding opportunitiesin AI and the state’s collaboration withIIT Hyderabadfor implementing AI-driven governance.Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, MGIT, visited the conference and encouraged the finalist teams, expressing gratitude to theMGIT Managementfor their support.Prof. K. Sudhakar Reddy, Vice Principal, congratulated the students on their exceptional performance.The success of MGIT’s participation was made possible through the dedicated mentorship ofDr. T. V. Rajinikanth, Professor & MGIT-Swecha SPOC, who guided the teams throughout the competition.Dr. Shyam, faculty member, also accompanied the students to the event.Adding further pride to MGIT,Mr. Sudharshan, PG alumnus of MGIT, was invited as aguest speaker, delivering a session on“Prompt Engineering”during the conference.

Swecha Foundation successfully organizedAI Hack Day 2025, a multi-domain hackathon competition featuring over120 real-world problemsin areas such as Art, Music, Video, Agriculture, Education, Healthcare, Gaming, and Storytelling. The event began with the preliminary round held on25th January 2024, where72 teams from MGITparticipated.
We are proud to announce that21 MGIT teamswere shortlisted asfinalistsfor theAI Days 2025 – International Conference, held on12th and 13th April 2025atTech Mahindra, Hitech City, Hyderabad. These finalist teams competed in the final round and are now being offeredinternship opportunities by top industries.
Among the finalists,two MGIT teams emerged as winners:
- 🏆Team Aarambh – 1st Place in Innovation Domain👩‍💻 Aditi Srigineedi – 21261A6701👩‍💻 Suchita Prakash – 21261A0557👨‍💻 Attaluri Sriram Satwik – 22261A6704
- 🥈Team Connect – 2nd Place in EdTech Domain👨‍💻 Mohammad Wahaj Uddin – 23261A1243👨‍💻 Malluri Vikas – 23261A1232👨‍💻 Mohammed Abrar – 23261A0445
The event witnessed participation from over1500 students and professionals, making it one of thelargest AI gatheringsin the region. Eminent speakers such asIAS Officer Mr. Bhavesh Mishra(Deputy Secretary, IT and Electronics Department, Govt. of Telangana),Dr. Pratap Reddy, andDr. Rameshinspired the audience with insights into the future of AI in governance and industry. Mr. Bhavesh Mishra also emphasized theTelangana Government’s initiatives and funding opportunitiesin AI and the state’s collaboration withIIT Hyderabadfor implementing AI-driven governance.
Dr. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy, Principal, MGIT, visited the conference and encouraged the finalist teams, expressing gratitude to theMGIT Managementfor their support.Prof. K. Sudhakar Reddy, Vice Principal, congratulated the students on their exceptional performance.
The success of MGIT’s participation was made possible through the dedicated mentorship ofDr. T. V. Rajinikanth, Professor & MGIT-Swecha SPOC, who guided the teams throughout the competition.Dr. Shyam, faculty member, also accompanied the students to the event.
Adding further pride to MGIT,Mr. Sudharshan, PG alumnus of MGIT, was invited as aguest speaker, delivering a session on“Prompt Engineering”during the conference.
